verdict.rationale: vLLM is an inference engine, and a tool of this kind could plausibly offer natural-language operation, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents serving features: an OpenAI-compatible chat API, tool calling and reasoning parsers. These let users chat with hosted models, not command vLLM itself (deploy, configure, benchmark) in natural language. The CLI is flag-based, so that is adjacent capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
